proposed_theorem.quantifiers: For every finite-dimensional Hilbert space H and every finite family E={rho_i}_{i=1}^n of states on H, define C(E)=max over priors p of chi(p,E), in nats. Let b(E)=inf_B max_{i,a in {1,2}} (1/2)||Tr_{other a} B(rho_i)-rho_i||_1 over one CPTP B:L(H)->L(H tensor H). Let e(E)=inf_Lambda max_i (1/2)||Lambda(rho_i)-rho_i||_1 over one entanglement-breaking CPTP Lambda:L(H)->L(H). Then e(E)<=min{1,400 sqrt((C(E)+1)/ln(1/b(E)))} for 0<b(E)<1, and b(E)=0 implies e(E)=0.
proposed_theorem.supplied_information: The family E, a single approximate two-output broadcaster B witnessing b(E), and the max-prior Holevo capacity C(E). No unitality assumption on B.
proposed_theorem.acquired_information: A single EB channel Lambda uniform over all labels, with worst-state half trace-norm reconstruction error.
proposed_theorem.costs: Dimension and family size are absent from the proposed modulus; the logarithm uses natural units and C is in nats.

opportunities.historical_importance: Would quantitatively connect approximate shareability of an entire finite quantum experiment to approximate classical sufficiency, with capacity controlling the uniform error independently of ambient dimension.

strongest_prior_work.interface: Any symmetric M-output broadcaster has a one-output EB approximation with diamond error at most 2 d^2/M for arbitrary permutation-invariant outputs.
strongest_prior_work.relation: Iterating a two-output broadcaster gives e(E)<=t b(E)+d^2/2^t, hence fixed-d qualitative stability. The result retains d and log(d^2/b) dependence and has no Holevo-capacity parameter.

strongest_prior_work.interface: Exact broadcastability of a finite statistical experiment is equivalent to CP-equivalence to a classical experiment.
strongest_prior_work.relation: Explains b=0 => e=0, but has no approximate modulus.

strongest_prior_work.interface: Permutation-covariant n-input/n-output channels have reduced channels CP-dominated by mixtures of tensor-power channels; exponential variant uses almost-iid channels under no-signalling.
strongest_prior_work.relation: Recent channel de Finetti result but different input/output symmetry, arbitrary channel approximants, and no finite-family capacity or EB objective.

strongest_prior_work.interface: k-extendible states admit a separable approximation in a local measurement norm bounded by sqrt(2 ln(dim Atilde)/k), averaged over tested operations.
strongest_prior_work.relation: Entropic, dimension-light analogue with average/local-measurement guarantees, not worst-label full trace reconstruction by a common EB map.

opportunities.concrete_mechanism_if_priority_survives: Turn a common approximate two-output broadcaster into a classical sufficient experiment, using max-prior Holevo capacity to replace the ambient dimension cost in finite de Finetti or entropic de Finetti arguments, while preserving worst-case labels and one common measurement-prepare map.
opportunities.load_bearing_literature_gate: A dimension-free stability theorem that takes only max-prior Holevo capacity C(E) and worst-label two-output marginal error b(E) as inputs and produces one EB Lambda with max-label trace error tending to zero as b tends to zero. Existing exact no-broadcasting, Le Cam randomization, and de Finetti results inspected do not state this parameter package.
compatibility_obligations: Keep fixed-prior Holevo information distinct from C(E)=sup_p chi(p,E).
Keep average-prior distortion distinct from the maximum over labels.
Keep approximate two-shareability of the given family distinct from a supplied symmetric M-output extension for every input state.
Keep a common EB reconstruction distinct from pairwise recovery or state-dependent preparation.
opportunities.early_falsification_test: Search for finite families with uniformly bounded max-prior Holevo capacity, b(E)->0, and e(E) bounded below. A certified sequence would refute the dimension-free qualitative endpoint; for the numerical constant/rate, search exact small-dimension SDP instances and highly asymmetric prior families, while treating finite success only as a diagnostic.
opportunities.significance_if_established: Would strengthen exact no-broadcasting and fixed-d de Finetti stability into a capacity-controlled, dimension-independent approximate classicalization theorem for finite quantum experiments.
